caption:
19 years as an investment banker. At 49, she quit to sell lipstick online. She's now India's richest self-made woman.

Falguni Nayar spent nearly two decades at Kotak Mahindra, rising to managing director of its investment banking arm and opening its London and New York offices. At 49 - with an elite finance career most people would never walk away from - she left it all to start Nykaa, a beauty e-commerce company, in an industry she had zero operating experience in. She put in 2 million dollars of her own and her husband's money to get it off the ground. Nykaa went public in 2021 and Nayar became India's wealthiest self-made woman. She didn't start over because the first career failed. She started over because she wanted to build something of her own, with no safety net left to fall back on.
